description: This file defines the GrainDirectoryAttribute class, a custom attribute used to specify the grain directory provider for a grain class in Orleans. It includes constructors, a property for the directory name, and a method to populate properties with this information.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryAttribute
classes.description: A sealed attribute class used to specify the grain directory provider for a grain class in Orleans.

methods.name: GrainDirectoryAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with the default grain directory name.

methods.name: GrainDirectoryAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with a specified grain directory name.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Method to populate the properties dictionary with the grain directory name.
